description: INSPIRE-WMS Transport Networks / Klassifiziertes Straßennetz inkl. straßenbegleitender Radwege BB is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Brandenburg. Er gibt einen Überblick über die Geodaten zum klassifizierten Straßennetz im Land Brandenburg. Coverage: Open Data Brandenburg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Brandenburg. Its tags are brandenburg, bundesautobahn, bundesstrasse, eroad, formofway. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XML. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
